Name: Pet Waters Crops
Author: HuTaoManiac
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Do you find your pet is not very useful? This mod will make your pet help you water the crops every day. Not only does it support watering crops on the farm, but it also includes greenhouses (including mods that add greenhouses to the game) and Ginger Island. Pets also help you check the types of crops in different areas and notify you when there are crops ready to be harvested.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Make sure you have downloaded the necessary mods like SMAPI, and GMCM.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

After receiving the pet, every day at a specific time (you can customize it via GMCM) during the first year. In the second year, it will automatically turn off and you can completely turn it on again.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]SMAPI, GMCM[/color]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
The current mod only has English, you are completely free to translate it as you like without going through me.
